title: The skill authoring flow can't run as decided: S2 needs an intake, and release strips the executable bit from 162 skill scripts
context: Following D-01M6CG6W9M6GN70AW52REH71SZ (skip S0/S1/S5/S6) hits two blockers before any of the 110 changed skills can release. (1) S3 draft requires S2 evidence passed, and S2 (src/authoring/stages/sources.ts runEvidence) refuses when intake.yaml is missing, which it always is once S1 is overridden; S2 also runs the overlap check, so check-tickets, write-tickets, decide-together, get-connected and post-tickets would wait on authoring.overlap packets. S2 is not in the approved skip list. (2) S3 draft copies text files into the workspace with workspace.write (writeFileSync with no mode, so 0644), and S7 release (src/authoring/stages/release.ts copyIntoHost) runs rmSync on the runtime source folder and copies the draft back over it. That drops the executable bit on 162 tracked 100755 scripts in 69 changed skills (for example runtime/base/skills/acceptance-criteria-gen/scripts/*.sh). git core.fileMode is true, so release would change committed skill files. Nothing has been run yet: no override packets, no workspaces.
